# ResonateAndFireNeurons

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking neuron model that uses a resonant frequency to generate spike responses, enabling frequency-selective signal processing. Enables efficient analog-like computation in neuromorphic hardware, critical for low-power split computing in wireless edge networks.
